opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 1, projects should start from early June 2026 to early December 2026.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified in late November regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 2, projects should start from early December 2026 to early June 2027.

amount.raw: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. The groups must have a diverse mix of members at different career stages, a diversity of institutions and have international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 30 April and close on 17 May. You will be notified by the end of May regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late May to late September.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 24 August and close on 8 September. You will be notified by the end of September regarding the outcome of your application. Applications should be for training and events that take place from late September to late January the following year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Projects should be a maximum of 12 months.

amount.raw: Helping PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses, or the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member. Must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher. Must work or study at a university or research institution. Must give a presentation if attending a meeting.
opportunities.summary: Helping PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses, or the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: BES Annual Meeting Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member. Must be a citizen of and based in the Global South. Must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting. Must be at least three years since you were last awarded a BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supporting researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK.

opportunities.title: John L Harper Award

deadlines.raw: Applications open on 12 January and close on 10 March. You will be notified in late May regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 1, projects should start from early June 2026 to early December 2026.

next_open_date.raw: Applications open on 8 June and close on 8 September. You will be notified in late November regarding the outcome of your application. If you apply during round 2, projects should start from early December 2026 to early June 2027.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership. Suitable research includes investigations that include detailed study of populations, and which follow the fate of plant populations for prolonged periods (e.g. generations, or over periods of years). Studies that include investigations of organisms that have ecologically important interactions with plant populations shall also be considered.
opportunities.summary: Awards an additional small research grant each year to research projects that are broadly consistent with the research themes advanced by the late John L. Harper.
